name: HelpCenter
task: Website or Shopify chat & FAQ deflection
summary: Shopify helpdesk with live chat and an AI FAQ builder: email, chat and Messenger in one ticket queue, plus SEO-friendly FAQ pages.
best_for: small Shopify stores that want ticketing, live chat and a searchable FAQ page from one app rather than bolting three together
skip_if: you already run a general helpdesk like Zendesk or Freshdesk for a business wider than the store: this is Shopify-shaped, not company-shaped
honest_knock: The free tier is the hook and the FAQ builder is the reason people stay. But the meter is tickets, not agents, and since the ladder changed there is no small paid tier any more: the first step up from Free is Standard at $40 a month. Free charges $0.25 for every ticket past ten, so a store doing around 170 tickets a month pays as much in overage as Standard costs. One dependency worth knowing: translating FAQs into many languages is handed off to a separate app (LangShop), so a multilingual store can end up with two subscriptions.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Standard · per month, or $400 a year
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-11-01 on apps.shopify.com/helpcenter) Free to install, and the meter is tickets rather than agents. The plan ladder changed since our earlier reading: the small Basic tier is gone, so the first paid step is now Standard. Free covers 10 tickets a month and charges $0.25 for each one after that. Standard is $40 a month or $400 a year (the listing says this saves 17%) for 500 tickets, then $0.15 each, with unlimited seats. Advanced is $70 or $700 a year for 1,000 tickets, then $0.12. Enterprise is $120 or $1,200 a year for 2,000 tickets, then $0.10 per ticket (the listing prints it as “0.1 per ticket”), and adds a dedicated account manager. Every paid tier carries a 14-day free trial and all charges are billed in USD. Which means the jump from free to paid is now $0 to $40: on Free, 170 tickets a month cost $40 in overage, so below that volume staying on Free is cheaper than Standard. The App Store lists it as “SB: Helpdesk, Live Chat & FAQs” from Shark Byte, Inc — the product calls itself HelpCenter, so you will see both names. Rating 4.6 from 318 reviews on 1 November 2026.
